abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Energy Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 1 Energy card from your hand. Then draw up to 3 cards from your deck. This power can't be used if Delcatty is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Max Energy Source
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Active Pokémon.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Water Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a {Water} Energy card from your hand to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Magnetic Field
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have basic Energy cards in your discard pile, you may discard any 1 card from your hand. Then search for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. You can't return the card you first discarded to your hand in this way. This power can't be used if Magneton is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Magnetic Force
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Pokémon (including Magneton).

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Wobbuffet by your opponent's Pokémon-ex.

attacks.name: Flip Over
attacks.text: Wobbuffet does 10 damage to itself, and don't apply Weakness and Resistance to this damage.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Lullaby
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Strike and Run
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. You may switch Dunsparce with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sudden Flash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, each Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.name: Ancient Technical Machine [Rock]

attacks.name: Stone Generator
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Evolved Pokémon in play, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of them and put those cards back into his or her hand.

effect: Attach this card to 1 of your Evolved Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex and Pokémon that has an owner in its name) in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard Ancient Technical Machine [Rock].

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.)

text.name: Wally's Training
effect: Search your deck for a card that evolves from your Active Pokémon (choose 1 if there are 2) and put it on your Active Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Potion
effect: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

text.name: Steven's Advice
effect: Draw a number of cards up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play.
If you have more than 7 cards (including this one) in your hand, you can't play this card.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Switch
effect: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.name: Multi Energy
effect: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) Multi Energy provides {Colorless} Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Energy Flip
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. You may move an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Reverse Stream
attacks.text: You may return all basic Energy cards attached to Suicune ex to your hand. If you do, this attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each basic Energy card you returned.

rules.label: Pokémon-ex rule
rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hyper Pump
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each basic Energy attached to Swampert ex but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 80 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Crushing Wave
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. After doing damage, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent discards an Energy card, if any, attached to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance to Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Pokémon-ex rule
rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Pokémon Fan Club
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon cards and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Oracle
effect: Choose 2 cards from your deck and shuffle the rest of your deck. Put the chosen cards on top of your deck in any order.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Copycat
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, count the number of cards in your opponent's hand and draw that many cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Underground Expedition
effect: Look at the bottom 4 cards of your deck. Put 2 of those cards into your hand, and then return the remaining cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Professor Elm's Training Method
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Professor Oak's Research
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 5 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
